verdict.rationale: The evidence pack covers full-text/sparse search, multi-vector search, filtering, multi-tenancy, RBAC, and MCP integration, but contains no mention of reranking models—neither a built-in reranker nor a first-party reranking integration (e.g., cross-encoder or BGE-reranker support). Missing for 10: any documentation of a reranking API, built-in rerank function, or first-party reranker model integration and evidence of its use in search pipelines.
